source.title: The human brain reactivates context-specific past information at event boundaries of naturalistic experiences

confidence_rationale: Peer-reviewed human fMRI with replication across two naturalistic datasets. Past-event representations reactivated in hippocampus and default-mode regions at event boundaries, and reactivation was selective for past events relevant to the current narrative context. This directly supports the weaker biological analogue of MECH-547 -- current context determines which already-stored information is exposed/reinstated -- while not demonstrating a learned latent T(sender,receiver) mapping or proving receiver-side state is the conditioning variable.
failure_signatures: If a REE T(A,B) gain survives receiver-state permutation, this paper does not rescue MECH-547: context-selective biological reactivation is not evidence that receiver state causally conditions the bridge.
If sender-side cue selection T(A) explains the same gain as T(A,B), the biological result is compatible with cue-conditioned indexing rather than receiver-conditioned translation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: During naturalistic narrative comprehension, neural representations of relevant past events reactivate at event boundaries in hippocampus and default-mode regions; reactivation is selective for contextually relevant past events.
mapping.ree_translation: Adjacent biological support for MECH-547: the current state of an ongoing process can select which part of stored information becomes exposed to downstream systems. The result motivates receiver/context-conditioned read surfaces rather than a universal fixed readout.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The experiment measures selective reactivation, not an explicit cross-representational translation function; current narrative context may operate as a sender-side retrieval cue rather than receiver-state conditioning in the MECH-547 sense.
mapping.source_context: Human fMRI; naturalistic narratives; event-boundary reactivation; replicated across two datasets.

confidence_components.notes: Strong source and clean context-selectivity result; moderate mapping because translation and receiver-state causality are not directly tested.
